name: app-uiux-design-long-sheet-home-analytics-assistant-pages
title: UI/UX Design Sheet: Home, Analytics and Assistant
whatItIs: A tall pale sheet titled UI/UX Design with three large phones alternating right, left, right (home, analytics, assistant), each with a heading and description at the opposite side joined by a blue line and small component cards or chips beneath.
whatItMeans: Alternating placement and blue connectors turn a list of screens into a readable story.
techniques: Blue leader lines with a dot to each caption
Small extracted component cards below captions
Large light headline with a bold key phrase

vocabulary.definition: Elements alternating sides down a page.
A thin line linking a caption to its screen.
A small copy of a UI piece shown beside its screen.
